rejected.title: Healthy and respectful relationships
card: A healthy relationship is one where both people feel valued and safe. It can be a friendship, a family bond or a romantic relationship.
Respect and trust
Respect means treating the other person's views, feelings and choices as important, even when you disagree. Trust means believing the other person is reliable and cares about you.
Honesty and safety
Honesty means telling the truth and being open about your feelings. Safety means feeling free from fear, harm and pressure, in body and mind.
Relationships with these features can support health and development. They can build self-esteem, a sense of belonging and the confidence to cope with problems.
rejected.remember: Respect, trust, honesty and safety mark a healthy relationship, and such relationships can support wellbeing.

a.q: Which situation shows respect in a friendship?
opts: Ava listens to Noor's different view and accepts her choice
Ava agrees with Noor so that they do not argue
Ava tells Noor which choice is the right one to make
Ava keeps her own view to herself and avoids Noor
a.why: Respect means treating the other person's views and choices as important, even when you disagree. Agreeing only to avoid an argument is tempting, but it does not value either person's real view.
a.clue: Respect still works when two people disagree.

b.q: Mia's partner often tells her who she can talk to and checks her phone. Mia says she feels afraid to refuse. Which feature of a healthy relationship is most clearly missing?
opts: Safety
Honesty
Humour
Shared interests
b.why: Mia feels afraid and pressured, so she is not free from fear or pressure, which means safety is missing. Honesty is tempting, but the main problem described is Mia's fear and lack of freedom.
b.clue: Look at how Mia feels when she thinks about refusing.

version.title: Healthy and respectful relationships
card: A healthy relationship is one where each person feels valued and safe. It can be a friendship, a family bond or a romantic relationship.
Respect and trust
respect means treating the other person's views, feelings and choices as important, even in a disagreement. Trust means relying on each other to keep promises and to care.
Honesty and safety
honesty means telling the truth and being open about feelings. Safety means being free from fear, harm and pressure, in body and mind.
Relationships with these features can support health and development. They can build self-esteem, a sense of belonging and the confidence to cope with problems.
version.remember: Respect, trust, honesty and safety make a relationship healthy, and a healthy relationship can help a person grow.

a.q: Ava and Noor disagree about which subjects to take next year. Which response by Ava shows respect?
opts: Ava listens to Noor's reasons and accepts her choice
Ava agrees with Noor just to avoid an argument
Ava tells Noor which subjects she should choose
Ava stops talking to Noor until she changes her mind
a.why: Respect means treating the other person's views and choices as important, even in a disagreement. Agreeing just to avoid an argument is tempting, but it hides Ava's real view rather than valuing both.
a.clue: Respect still works when two people disagree.

b.q: Jordan's friend says Jordan will be dropped from the group for spending time with anyone else. Jordan feels too afraid to say no. Which feature of a healthy relationship is most clearly missing?
opts: Safety
Honesty
Humour
Shared hobbies
b.why: Jordan feels afraid and pressured, so Jordan is not free from fear or pressure, which means safety is missing. Nothing suggests the friend is lying, so honesty is not the clearest gap.
b.clue: Look at how Jordan feels about saying no.

a.best: Ava listens to Noor's reasons and accepts her choice
